description: Test whether the Nvj3 C-terminal half completes its own PXA conduit, and summarise PXA vs PXA+PXC cavity geometry
code:
exec(open("cavity_tools_src.py").read(), globals())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
at=parse_pdb("struct/NVJ3_yeast.pdb")
# Does the Nvj3 C-terminal half pack against the PXA module (PXC-like role)?
A=at[(at["resi"]>=61)&(at["resi"]<=253)]; C=at[(at["resi"]>=254)&(at["resi"]<=463)]
xa=np.stack([A["x"],A["y"],A["z"]],1).astype(float); xc=np.stack([C["x"],C["y"],C["z"]],1).astype(float)
d=np.linalg.norm(xa[:,None,:]-xc[None,:,:],axis=2)
print(f"Nvj3 PXA-module(61-253) vs C-terminal(254-463): min dist={d.min():.2f} A, heavy-atom contacts <4.5A = {int((d<4.5).sum())}, "
      f"interface residues: {len(np.unique(A['resi'][np.where(d<4.5)[0]]))} (N-side) / {len(np.unique(C['resi'][np.where(d<4.5)[1]]))} (C-side)")

rows=[]
for lab,(s,e) in [("PXA module 61-253",(61,253)),("C-terminal 254-463",(254,463)),("ordered 61-463",(61,463))]:
    pk=find_pockets(subset(at,s,e), psp_min=6); t=pk[0] if pk else None
    nres=len(np.unique(subset(at,s,e)["resi"]))
    lin=t["lining_resi"] if t else []
    rows.append(dict(region=lab,n_res=nres,top_vol=round(t["volume"],0) if t else 0,
        KD=round(t["mean_KD"],2) if t else np.nan, apolar=round(t["apolar_atom_frac"],3) if t else np.nan,
        long_axis=round(t["long_axis"],1) if t else np.nan,
        fully_buried=round(t["fully_buried_frac"],3) if t else np.nan,
        n_lining=len(lin),
        lining_in_PXAmod=int(sum(1 for r in lin if r<=253)), lining_in_Cterm=int(sum(1 for r in lin if r>253))))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(df.to_string(index=False)); df.to_csv("nvj3_conduit_regions.csv",index=False)

# figure: summary of the PXA/PXC comparison
pp=pd.read_csv("pxa_pxc_cavity.csv")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
sub=pp[pp.module.isin(["PXA only","PXA+PXC"])]
prot=sorted(sub.protein.unique()); w=0.38; x=np.arange(len(prot))
for i,m in enumerate(["PXA only","PXA+PXC"]):
    v=[float(sub[(sub.protein==p)&(sub.module==m)].top_vol.iloc[0]) for p in prot]
    ax[0].bar(x+(i-0.5)*w, v, w, label=m, color=["#95a5a6","#c0392b"][i])
nv=pp[pp.protein=="NVJ3_yeast"]
ax[0].axhline(float(nv[nv.module=="PXA module 61-253"].top_vol.iloc[0]), color="#2980b9", ls="--",
              label="Nvj3 PXA module alone")
ax[0].axhline(float(nv[nv.module=="full length 1-463"].top_vol.iloc[0]), color="#16a085", ls=":",
              label="Nvj3 full length")
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels([p.replace("_human","").replace("_yeast","") for p in prot],rotation=20)
ax[0].set_ylabel("largest cavity volume (A^3)"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title("PXC domain completes the PXA conduit (AlphaFold monomers, LIGSITE PSP>=6)",fontsize=10)

ax[1].bar(x-0.5*w,[float(sub[(sub.protein==p)&(sub.module=='PXA only')].long_axis.iloc[0]) for p in prot],w,color="#95a5a6",label="PXA only")
ax[1].bar(x+0.5*w,[float(sub[(sub.protein==p)&(sub.module=='PXA+PXC')].long_axis.iloc[0]) for p in prot],w,color="#c0392b",label="PXA+PXC")
ax[1].axhline(float(nv[nv.module=="PXA module 61-253"].long_axis.iloc[0]),color="#2980b9",ls="--",label="Nvj3 PXA module alone")
ax[1].axhline(float(nv[nv.module=="full length 1-463"].long_axis.iloc[0]),color="#16a085",ls=":",label="Nvj3 full length")
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels([p.replace("_human","").replace("_yeast","") for p in prot],rotation=20)
ax[1].set_ylabel("cavity long axis (A)"); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8); ax[1].set_title("Conduit length",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
